entities.name: Rise of the Skyclaves
entities.description: Reactivation and levitation of the ancient Skyclave ruins on Zendikar around 4561 AR.

entities.name: Skyclaves
entities.description: Floating fortresses built by the Kor Empire over the continents of Zendikar.

entities.name: Kor Empire
entities.description: Empire that built the Skyclaves and later collapsed.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: The Sky Ruin, remains of the Tazeem Skyclave, destroyed by Iona.

entities.name: Obuun
entities.description: Elf warrior who led the Bala Ged rebellion before becoming a spirit.

entities.name: Lorthos, the Tidemaker
entities.description: Aquatic beast possibly responsible for the Murasa Skyclave's fall.

entities.name: Kargan tribes
entities.description: Tribes of Akoum who shattered the Akoum Skyclave with dragons.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: Archangel of Emeria who destroyed the Tazeem Skyclave.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: Planeswalker who lured the Eldrazi to Zendikar.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans lured to Zendikar; one destroyed the Sejiri Skyclave.

entities.name: Kesenya
entities.description: Leader of the adventurers who triggered Emeria's defenses.

entities.name: Sea Gate Expeditionary House
entities.description: Expeditionary House founded by the adventurers who explored Emeria.

events.summary: The Kor Empire collapses and each Skyclave falls in a different way, from the Roil, rebellion, a sea beast, civil war, Kargan dragons, Iona, and an Eldrazi titan.
events.quote: over a century, the empire fractured and ultimately collapsed

events.summary: Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin lure the Eldrazi; a titan destroys the Sejiri Skyclave.
events.quote: one of the titans destroyed the Sejiri Skyclave with a single flick of a tentacle

events.summary: Kesenya's adventurers inadvertently trigger Emeria's defenses, awakening six more Skyclaves.
events.quote: the adventurers inadvertently triggered the Skyclave's dormant magical defenses

events.summary: The adventurers retrieve relics and found the Sea Gate Expeditionary House, inspiring new expeditions.
events.quote: became the founding members of the newly founded Sea Gate Expeditionary House

relations.quote: constructed immense floating fortresses called Skyclaves
